note: SystemVerilog `logic` in an ANSI port header. CURRENTLY FAILS, DELIBERATELY, on hif-frontend#33: verilog2hif parses a port's type as a Verilog-AMS discipline and rejects `logic` as an unsupported identifier, aborting. The same keyword in a body declaration works - hif-frontend#21 - and systemverilog_logic.v covers that, with untyped ports for this reason. This design is the port form that omission left unasked.
